interview.project_pitch: A native macOS dashboard showing per-account quota for local Claude Code, Codex, and Vertex AI sessions — read-only, on-device, no credential writes.
interview.sacred_ground: Credential handling — never exchange OAuth refresh tokens, never place tokens in args/env/logs, never publish personal emails or project names

notes: Minimal install: .professor metadata + the rr skill only. No commands, hooks, statusline, or tier-B roles. Run the full ~/.professor interactive installer if the project ever needs them.
